versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-object-remover skill.

- Enables users to remove an unwanted person, object, logo, or distraction from videos they own.
- Guides through video selection, object targeting, mask confirmation, and erasing process using the Video Object Remover API.
- Supports MP4, MOV, WebM videos up to 100 MB; free preview available for new accounts.
- Enforces clear confirmation before removing objects, protecting user accounts and API key security.
- Reports API errors clearly without retrying failed requests automatically.
